title: Customer Care System Reference: Damage Allowance Accepted on Paid-in-Full Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
**Applies to.** The damage allowance on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 100 percent of the order total (paid in full when the order is placed), when covered cosmetic damage was reported at the customer handover and the customer chooses to keep the item. The allowance is booked once, as a damage allowance credit against that damage claim, at the customer's request.

## Standing condition

The allowance on a delivered order is fixed only after the home delivery charge owed for that delivery stands on the order as a fee line.

Put the other way: while the home delivery charge owed for the delivery does not yet stand on a delivered order as a fee line, the allowance on that order is not fixed.

**Business effect.** Accepting the allowance records the customer's remedy choice — keep the item with an allowance — on their damage claim, marks the claim completed today, and books one damage allowance credit line, dated today, that lowers the order's balance due by the allowance. The customer sees the claim closed with the allowance and the credit on the order.

## Tool: `accept_damage_allowance_e64dc664`

**Capability.** Records, in the customer's own hand, the acceptance of the damage allowance offered on a special order item that arrived with cosmetic damage, with the customer keeping the item.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, through `call_user_discoverable_tool`, with the parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `special_order_id` | the reference number of the special order the damaged item belongs to, as returned by the special order lookup for this customer | identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `special_request_id` | the reference number of the customer's open damage claim on that order, as returned by the special order request lookup | identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `allowance_amount` | the allowance being accepted | US dollars as a plain number with 2 decimal places (for example 312.75); the tool rounds to the nearest cent |

No parameter has an enumerated set of values.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence that begins "Damage allowance accepted" when the choice and the credit were recorded, carrying the credit line reference number (text starting "socr"), the damage claim reference number, the allowance credited (US dollars, 2 decimals) and the order's new balance due (US dollars, 2 decimals, negative when money is owed back).

## Reference questions

**Who runs the tool?** The customer themselves, after the agent has unlocked it and handed it over.

**What happens to the damage claim?** Its remedy choice becomes keep the item with an allowance, and it is marked completed today.
